szenen.text: Why did CLANKER jump 20% today? Here is what the data shows.
Over 7 days it is up just 0.3%. The jump only won back last week's losses.
Binance futures alone traded 9.3 million dollars. Coinbase spot: half a million.
All futures together traded about 67 times the spot volume. Leveraged bets set the price, not holders.
Verdict: a futures-driven rebound. We found no new announcement from the project today. Which coin should we explain next? Comment below.
